subject.title: fix(macos): refresh skills after local node reconnect

question: Which of the two overlapping open macOS reconnect-refresh PRs should be the single canonical landing candidate after native proof is supplied?
rationale: Both branches address the same reproduced issue, neither has sufficient real behavior proof, and choosing one determines the lasting notification and refresh-drain structure.

options.title: Prefer the parallel candidate after proof
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107660 as the canonical patch after it supplies native proof, because its explicit refresh-drain loop and injectable notification center make the lifecycle easier to isolate in tests.

options.title: Adopt this PR after proof
options.body: Keep this branch if its author supplies equivalent native proof and maintainers prefer its notification naming and dependency-injection shape.

options.title: Request a narrow consolidated successor
options.body: Close neither candidate yet and ask for one focused successor only if maintainers want to combine the preferred parts before proof and final review.

recommendation.title: Prefer the parallel candidate after proof
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107660 as the canonical patch after it supplies native proof, because its explicit refresh-drain loop and injectable notification center make the lifecycle easier to isolate in tests.
